items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Walter Devereaux? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No. I don't think so.

ctx.x: Well, if you go, Preston Love told me that they have a singer there called Walter Devereaux.
Yeah, and he plays guitar. And, he's a blues singer. And, he's Wynonie Harris's illegitimate son.
